rumours: Travellers in Thorn whisper that old toll-charters across Shadowfen are being bought up by secretive factors.
Watchmen along the Shadowfen trails say lanterns have been seen moving inside the ancient vaults after midnight.
Stewards serving Root-Speaker Xukas-Tei posted fresh commissions at Thorn for anyone who can secure the outlying ruins of Shadowfen.
Wayfarers resting in Shadowfen swear the roadside shrines hum softly whenever a storm rolls across the border.
Clerks in Thorn complain that sealed crates bypass the customs posts of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen without inspection.
Local folk in Shadowfen still leave an offering on the boundary stones to keep the older spirits quiet.
A chronicler arrived in Thorn last week asking after First and Second Era garrison rolls for Shadowfen.
Apothecaries in Thorn pay good silver for rare moss and resin gathered from the ruins of Shadowfen.
Veterans in Thorn still debate which company held the frontier pass of Shadowfen during the Crisis.
Smugglers working the back-tracks of Shadowfen use chipped milestones to mark their midnight drop-sites.
legends: In the First Era, when the earliest boundary stones were raised across Shadowfen, the watchtowers of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen echoed with bronze horns for seven nights.
Old ballads of Thorn tell of a standard-bearer who sealed his company's charter chest beneath a stronghold in Shadowfen and swore never to yield the key.
Folk in Shadowfen speak of the Twilight Surveyor, a phantom chronicler who walks the milestones toward Thorn during Frostfall, measuring whether the old pacts still hold.
Beneath the oldest foundations of Thorn, builders claim an unbroken subterranean conduit still links the shrines of Shadowfen.
During the Second Era interregnum, an envoy of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen walked alone into the deepest ruin of Shadowfen and returned with the truce-ring that still hangs in Thorn.
Every century when the moons align over Shadowfen, the sunken bells near Thorn are said to chime three times beneath the earth.
Carvers in Thorn preserve the tale of the First Warden of Shadowfen, who traded his shadow to seal the lower fault-gates against intruders.
According to the temple rolls of Thorn, the oldest road through Shadowfen follows the footprints of the ancestors who first named the land.

songs.title: The High Road to Thorn
lines: O the road to Thorn winds ancient and long,
Where the wardens of Shadowfen still march with a song;
Keep your lantern trimmed bright through the mist and the rain,
Till the gates of Thorn rise before us again.

songs.title: Watchfires of Shadowfen
lines: Raise a cup for Shadowfen, where the old beacons gleam,
Above ruin and valley, by causeway and stream;
Though the borderlands shift and the smugglers may scheme,
Still the folk of Thorn keep the ancestors' dream.

songs.title: Boundary Stones of Thorn
lines: From the pass to the harbour the mile-pillars stand,
Cut by chisels of old across Shadowfen's proud land;
Count the leagues into Thorn with steel in your hand,
For the spirits of Shadowfen bow to no stranger's command.

songs.title: Lamplight in Thorn
lines: When the dusk settles deep over Shadowfen's wide shore,
And the barges tie fast by the customhouse door;
May the wards of Thorn hold the night-wind at bay,
Till the horns of the morningwatch welcome the day.

arnesia.hook: Arnesia (town) stands at (7700, 4900) in Shadowfen, where the weathered masonry still bears the marks of Thorn's frontier history.
arnesia.rumour: Folks in Thorn say anyone who searches Arnesia in Shadowfen will find traces of the old wardens and recent smugglers' caches.
arnesia.quest: Investigate the reports surrounding Arnesia in Shadowfen and report to the wardens at Thorn.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Arnesia
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through Shadowfen, we set our transit-rod at Arnesia (survey grid 7700, 4900 under the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Thorn refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

notes.title: Warden's Dispatch: Arnesia
notes.author: Chancery of Thorn
pages: To the watch-corporal posted at Arnesia (7700, 4900): by warrant of Root-Speaker Xukas-Tei in Thorn, patrols along this sector of Shadowfen are to inspect all night-convoys bearing unsealed casks and report any broken boundary stones to the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen.

notes.title: Factor's Private Missive from Arnesia
notes.author: Factor-Clerk Vorian
pages: My dear colleague in Thorn: the inventory cached at Arnesia (grid 7700, 4900 in Shadowfen) remains untouched by the bailiffs of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen. So long as the border watches stay occupied, our drovers can move two dozen crates a week past Arnesia without paying toll.

notes.title: Antiquarian Notes on Arnesia
notes.author: Chronicler Mirabelle of the Archives
pages: Among the secondary sites of Shadowfen, Arnesia (situated at coordinates 7700, 4900 within the jurisdiction of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen) merits closer study. The stonework preserves tool-marks characteristic of early regional craft oriented toward Thorn.

notes.title: Wayfarer's Warning at Arnesia
notes.author: Road-Warden of Thorn
pages: Travellers bound for Thorn across Shadowfen: do not unhitch your teams at Arnesia (7700, 4900) after the evening mist rises. Outriders of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen reported hostile movement inside the perimeter of Arnesia last fortnight.

notes.title: Rubbing from the Boundary Stone at Arnesia
notes.author: Wayshrine Chronicler
pages: Transcribed from the weathered lintel at Arnesia (7700, 4900 in Shadowfen): 'Here stands the watch-stone of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen, raised to guard the approach to Thorn. Let whoever takes shelter within these walls keep the lamp lit and the threshold clean.'

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Arnesia
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Thorn
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Arnesia (grid 7700, 4900 in Shadowfen): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen at Thorn.

notes.title: Scout's Night-Watch Report: Arnesia
notes.author: Outrider of the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen
pages: Submitted to the guard-captain at Thorn: at midnight we observed lantern-signals flashing from the upper masonry of Arnesia (7700, 4900 in Shadowfen). Fresh tracks lead from the threshold toward the main road.
